verses.sloka: ऋश्यमूकात् तु हनुमान् गत्वा तम् मलयम् गिरिम् ।आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपि राजाय राघवौ ॥४-५-१॥
verses.transliteration: ṛśyamūkāt tu hanumān gatvā tam malayam girim ।ācacakṣe tadā vīrau kapi rājāya rāghavau ॥4-5-1॥

translations.english: Leaving Rishyamuka, Hanuman reached the Malaya mountain. Seeing the chief of monkeys there, he announced the arrival of the heroic Raghavas.
translations.hindi: —B— किष्क्रिन्धाकाण्ड का छुठवा सर्गे पूरा हुआ । १ विमथ्य-त्रश्चयित्वा । ( रा० ) सप्तसः सः एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणार्तेन वानरः । अब्रवीत्माझ्लियांक्यं सवाष्पं बाष्पगद्गदः

verses.sloka: अयम् रामो महाप्राज्ञ संप्राप्तो दृढ विक्रमः ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रामोऽयम् सत्य विक्रमः ॥४-५-२॥
verses.transliteration: ayam rāmo mahāprājña saṁprāpto dṛḍha vikramaḥ ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāmo'yam satya vikramaḥ ॥4-5-2॥

translations.english: 'This Rama of greatwisdom and valour, endowed with the power of truth has arrived here along with his brother Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातो रामो दशरथात्मजः ।धर्मे निगदितः च एव पितुर् निर्देश कारकः ॥४-५-३॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām kule jāto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ।dharme nigaditaḥ ca eva pitur nirdeśa kārakaḥ ॥4-5-3॥

translations.english: 'Born in the Ikshvaku race Rama Dasaratha's son, distinguished for his righteousness is here to carry out the orders of his father.
translations.hindi: किन्तु हे शत्रुनाशन ! मैं सत्य सि क्र फे कहता हूँ कि. जानकी जी को प्राप्त करने के लिए में कोई बात उठा न रखँगा । अतः अब आप शोक न कीजिए

verses.sloka: राजसूय अश्वमेधैः च वह्निः येन अभितर्पितः ।दक्षिणाः च तथा उत्सृष्टा गावः शत सहस्रशः ॥४-५-४॥
verses.transliteration: rājasūya aśvamedhaiḥ ca vahniḥ yena abhitarpitaḥ ।dakṣiṇāḥ ca tathā utsṛṣṭā gāvaḥ śata sahasraśaḥ ॥4-5-4॥

translations.english: 'While the great Rama armed with selfrestraint was living in the forest, his wife was abducted by Ravana. So he has come to you seeing refuge.
translations.hindi: बंशसहित रावण को मार कर और अपने पुरुषार्थ को सफल ह मैं ऐसा कार्य करूंगा जिससे आप प्रसन्न हो जाँयगे

verses.sloka: तपसा सत्य वाक्येन वसुधा येन पालिता ।स्त्री हेतोः तस्य पुत्रोऽयम् रामः अरणयम् समागतः ॥४-५-५॥
verses.transliteration: tapasā satya vākyena vasudhā yena pālitā ।strī hetoḥ tasya putro'yam rāmaḥ araṇayam samāgataḥ ॥4-5-5॥

translations.english: 'This Rama, son of a king who had gratified the firegod through many yajnas like Rajasuya and Aswamedha, gifted hundreds of thousands of cows and ruled this earth with truth and austerity, has come seeking help for a woman.'
translations.hindi: बस अत्र आप दीनता त्यागिए ओर धीरज रखिए। क्योंकि. आप जैसे पुरुषों को इस प्रकार की दीनता प्रदर्शित करना बड़ी: ओली बात है

verses.sloka: तस्य अस्य वसतो अरण्ये नियतस्य महात्मनः ।रावणेन हृता भार्या स त्वाम् शरणम् आगतः ॥४-५-६॥
verses.transliteration: tasya asya vasato araṇye niyatasya mahātmanaḥ ।rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā sa tvām śaraṇam āgataḥ ॥4-5-6॥

translations.english: 'This Rama, son of a king who had gratified the firegod through many yajnas like Rajasuya and Aswamedha, gifted hundreds of thousands of cows and ruled this earth with truth and austerity, has come seeking help for a woman.'
translations.hindi: मैं भी तो अपनी पत्नी के हरे जाने से बड़ा दुःख भोग रहा हँ ; किन्तु में इस प्रकार न तो दुःखी होता हूँ और न धीरज ही. छोड़ बेठता हूँ

verses.sloka: भवता सख्य कामौ तौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ।प्रगृह्य च अर्चयस्व एतौ पूजनीयतमौ उभौ ॥४-५-७॥
verses.transliteration: bhavatā sakhya kāmau tau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ।pragṛhya ca arcayasva etau pūjanīyatamau ubhau ॥4-5-7॥

translations.english: 'Both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana seek friendship with you. As both of them are worthiest of worship, welcome them with due reverence.'
translations.hindi: यद्यपि में अनार्य जाति का वानर हूँ तथापि में उसके लिए इतना चिन्तातुर नही हूँ । किर आप तो महात्मा, बड़े बूढ़ों दवारा सुशिक्षित, और धेयंवान्‌ पुरुष हैं

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः ।दर्शनीयतमो भूत्वा प्रीत्या उवाच राघवम् ॥४-५-८॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyam sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ ।darśanīyatamo bhūtvā prītyā uvāca rāghavam ॥4-5-8॥

translations.english: Hanuman's words took away Sugriva's great fear for Rama and filled him with cheer. This bull among monkeys gave up his natural appearance and and assuming an attractive human form spoke to Rama lovingly:

verses.sloka: भवान् धर्म विनीतः च सुतपाः सर्व वत्सलः ।आख्याता वायुपुत्रेण तत्त्वतो मे भवद् गुणाः ॥४-५-९॥
verses.transliteration: bhavān dharma vinītaḥ ca sutapāḥ sarva vatsalaḥ ।ākhyātā vāyuputreṇa tattvato me bhavad guṇāḥ ॥4-5-9॥

translations.english: Hanuman's words took away Sugriva's great fear for Rama and filled him with cheer. This bull among monkeys gave up his natural appearance and and assuming an attractive human form spoke to Rama lovingly:

verses.sloka: तन् मम एव एष सत्कारो लाभः च एव उत्तमः प्रभो ।यत् त्वम् इच्छसि सौहार्दम् वानरेण मया सह ॥४-५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tan mama eva eṣa satkāro lābhaḥ ca eva uttamaḥ prabho ।yat tvam icchasi sauhārdam vānareṇa mayā saha ॥4-5-10॥

translations.english: 'You are a great hero, affectionate to all and wellversed in all dharmas. The son of the Windgod has, in fact, apprised me of your virtues
translations.hindi: जो लोग मूर्ख होते हें, वे नित्य ही दीन बने रहते हैं । वे लाचार हा शोक में वैसे ही इब जाते हैं, जेसे बड़े बोझ से दवी हुई नाव पानी में डूब जाती है

verses.sloka: रोचते यदि मे सख्यम् बाहुः एष प्रसारितः ।गृह्यताम् पाणिना पाणिः मर्यादा बध्यताम् ध्रुवा ॥४-५-११॥
verses.transliteration: rocate yadi me sakhyam bāhuḥ eṣa prasāritaḥ ।gṛhyatām pāṇinā pāṇiḥ maryādā badhyatām dhruvā ॥4-5-11॥

translations.english: 'O Lord that you are eager to have friendship with me, who is a monkey is a great honour and is extremely beneficial to me.
translations.hindi: मैं आपसे हाथ जोड़ कर प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि, आप मेरी प्रीति की ओर देख कर, प्रसन्न हो ओर पुरुषार्थ का सहारा ले, शोक को अपने सन में पैठने का अवसर ही न दें

verses.sloka: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य सुभाषितम् ।संप्रहृष्ट मना हस्तम् पीडयामास पाणिना ॥४-५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sugrīvasya subhāṣitam ।saṁprahṛṣṭa manā hastam pīḍayāmāsa pāṇinā ॥4-5-12॥

translations.english: 'If you are desirous of my friendship, here is my arm (palm) stretched out to you. With due regard, establish our bond firmly, holding my palm in yours.'
translations.hindi: जो लोग शोक किआ करते हैं, वे कभी सुखी हो ही नहीं सकते । प्रत्युत उनके तेज की भी हानि होती है। अतः आपको शोक न करना चाहिए

verses.sloka: हृष्टः सौहृदम् आलम्ब्य पर्यष्वजत पीडितम् ।ततो हनूमान् संत्यज्य भिक्षु रूपम् अरिन्दमः ॥४-५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ sauhṛdam ālambya paryaṣvajata pīḍitam ।tato hanūmān saṁtyajya bhikṣu rūpam arindamaḥ ॥4-5-13॥

translations.english: Rama became very happy to hear Sugriva's warm words and pressed his hand with his. Delighted, he went close to Sugriva and hugged him tightly and affectionately.
translations.hindi: हे राजेन्द्र ! जो लोग सदा शोक में डूबे रहते हैं, उनके जीवन सें भी सन्देह ही जाता दै । अतः आप शोक को त्याग कर, केवलं घैये धारण कीजिए

verses.sloka: काष्ठयोः स्वेन रूपेण जनयामास पावकम् ।दीप्यमानम् ततो वह्निम् पुष्पैः अभ्यर्च्य सत्कृतम् ॥४-५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhayoḥ svena rūpeṇa janayāmāsa pāvakam ।dīpyamānam tato vahnim puṣpaiḥ abhyarcya satkṛtam ॥4-5-14॥

translations.english: Then, Hanuman vanquisher of enemies, gave up his guise of a mendicant, assumed his natural form and generated fire by rubbing two pieces of wood. Wellpleased at heart, he made an offering of flowers to the flaming fire and placed it between them.
translations.hindi: मैं केवल मित्रता के कर्तब्य से प्रेरित हा, आपसे आपके हित की बात कहता हूँ--मैं आपको उपदेश नहीं देता । अतः आप मेरी मैत्री को मान. शोक मत कीजिए

verses.sloka: तयोर् मध्ये तु सुप्रीतो निदधौ सुसमाहितः ।ततो अग्निम् दीप्यमानम् तौ चक्रतुः च प्रदक्षिणम् ॥४-५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: tayor madhye tu suprīto nidadhau susamāhitaḥ ।tato agnim dīpyamānam tau cakratuḥ ca pradakṣiṇam ॥4-5-15॥

translations.english: Then, Hanuman vanquisher of enemies, gave up his guise of a mendicant, assumed his natural form and generated fire by rubbing two pieces of wood. Wellpleased at heart, he made an offering of flowers to the flaming fire and placed it between them.
translations.hindi: जब सुग्रीव ने श्रीराम को इस प्रकार मधुर बचनों से सम- काया, तब श्रीरामचन्द्र अपने कपड़े के छोर से, आंसू से भरे अपने सुख को पोंछ, स्वस्थ दो एवं सुग्रीव को हृदय से लगा कर. यह वात बोले

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो राघवः च एव वयस्यत्वम् उपागतौ ।ततः सुप्रीत मनसौ तौ उभौ हरि राघवौ ॥४-५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo rāghavaḥ ca eva vayasyatvam upāgatau ।tataḥ suprīta manasau tau ubhau hari rāghavau ॥4-5-16॥

translations.english: They both circumambulated the blazing fire and solemnized their friendship.

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्तौ न तृप्तिम् अभिजग्मतुः ।त्वम् वयस्योऽसि हृद्यः मे हि एकम् दुःखम् सुखम् च नौ ॥४-५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: anyonyam abhivīkṣantau na tṛptim abhijagmatuḥ ।tvam vayasyo'si hṛdyaḥ me hi ekam duḥkham sukham ca nau ॥4-5-17॥

translations.english: Rama and the monkey contented at heart, yet not fully content, continued looking at each other.
translations.hindi: हे सुग्रीव ! स्नेह और हितैषी मित्र के अजुरूप और योग्य काये तुमने किआ है

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो राघवम् वाक्यम् इति उवाच प्रहृष्टवत् ।ततः सुपर्ण बहुलाम् भंक्त्वा शाखाम् सुपुष्पिताम् ॥४-५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo rāghavam vākyam iti uvāca prahṛṣṭavat ।tataḥ suparṇa bahulām bhaṁktvā śākhām supuṣpitām ॥4-5-18॥

translations.english: 'You are a dear friend to me. Your sorrow is my sorrow, your pleasure is my pleasure. We are one and the same' said Sugriva to Rama, his heart overflowing with happiness.
translations.hindi: हे मित्र ! तुम्हारे समझाने बुझाने से मेरा मन ठीक हो गया है । तुम्हारे जैसा मित्र मिलना दुलेभ है ) सो भी ऐसी विपत्ति के समय

verses.sloka: सालस्य आस्तीर्य सुग्रीवः निषसाद स राघवः ।लक्ष्मनाय अथ संहृष्टो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥४-५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sālasya āstīrya sugrīvaḥ niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ ।lakṣmanāya atha saṁhṛṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ॥4-5-19॥

translations.english: Then Sugriva cut the branch of a sala tree with luxuriant leaves and flowers, spread it on the ground and sat down along with Raghava.

verses.sloka: शखाम् चन्दन वृक्षस्य ददौ परम पुष्पिताम् ।ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा ॥४-५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: śakhām candana vṛkṣasya dadau parama puṣpitām ।tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ ślakṣṇam madhurayā girā ॥4-5-20॥

translations.english: Then Hanuman, the bull among monkeys, felt very happy, cut the branch of a sandalwood tree full of flowers and gave it to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: अपना जो काम तुम मुझसे करवाना चाहते हो सो तुम मुझसे बेधड़क कहो । में तुम्हारे सब काम उसी प्रकार सिद्ध कर दूंगा जिस प्रकार उपजाऊँ खेत में वर्षा ऋतु में बोया हुआ बीज सफल होता है

verses.sloka: प्रति उवाच तदा रामम् हर्ष व्याकुल लोचनः ।अहम् विनिकृतो राम चरमि इह भय आर्दितः ॥४-५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: prati uvāca tadā rāmam harṣa vyākula locanaḥ ।aham vinikṛto rāma carami iha bhaya ārditaḥ ॥4-5-21॥

translations.english: Then Sugriva, eyes sparkling with joy, replied to Rama in a sweet, gentle voice.
translations.hindi: हे वानरश्रेष्ठ ! मेंने शौयोभिमान से जो बात कही है इसे तुम सत्य सत्य ही ज्ञानना । क्योंकि न तो पहले सें कभी मिथ्या बोला १ इ ञ्रभिमानात्--शौर्योभिमानात्‌। (गोऽ) (0770 | ( गोऽ) ) ह | (इक हे: सग. ओर न आगे हो कभी बोलूँगा | इस बात के लिए में प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ ओर सत्यतापूबक शपथ खाता हू

verses.sloka: हृत भार्यो वने त्रस्तो दुर्गम् एतत् उपाश्रितः ।सोऽहम् त्रस्तो वने भीतो वसामि उद् भ्रान्त चेतनः ॥४-५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: hṛta bhāryo vane trasto durgam etat upāśritaḥ ।so'ham trasto vane bhīto vasāmi ud bhrānta cetanaḥ ॥4-5-22॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, I have been insulted deeply and my wife hijacked. Stricken with fear I have taken refuge in this inaccessible forest.

verses.sloka: वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृत वैरः च राघव ।वालिनो मे महाभाग भय आर्तस्य अभयम् कुरु ॥४-५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava ।vālino me mahābhāga bhaya ārtasya abhayam kuru ॥4-5-23॥

translations.english: 'O Rama humiliated by my brother Vali, I have developed enmity with him. Terribly distraught and disturbed I live in this forest in great fear.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के इन वचनों को सुन कर सुग्रीव अपने मंत्रियों सहित बहुत प्रसन्न हुए--विशेष श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की श्रतिज्ञा को सत्य जान उन्होंने अपने को कृताथ माना

verses.sloka: कर्तुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थः भयम् मे न भवेद् यथा ।एवम् उक्तः तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः ॥४-५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: kartum arhasi kākutsthaḥ bhayam me na bhaved yathā ।evam uktaḥ tu tejasvī dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ ॥4-5-24॥

translations.english: 'O reverend Kakutstha, I feel helpless with fear from Vali. Save me. You should release me free from fear.'
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार एकान्त में वेठ वे दोनों नर और वानर अपने अपने सुख दुःख आपस में कहते सुनते थे

verses.sloka: प्रति अभाषत काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव ।उपकार फलम् मित्रम् विदितम् मे महाकपे ॥४-५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: prati abhāṣata kākutsthaḥ sugrīvam prahasan iva ।upakāra phalam mitram viditam me mahākape ॥4-5-25॥

translations.english: The righteous and glorious Rama to whom dharma is very dear said to Sugriva with a gentle smile on his face, when he was entreated thus:
translations.hindi: इति सप्तम: सगः ॥ वानरराज सुप्रीत ने राजराडेश्‍वर श्रीरामचन्द्र के बचन सुन मन ही मन विचार किआ कि, निस्सन्देह्‌ अब मेरा कार्ये हो गया | अथवा सुग्रीव ने अपना काय पूर्ण हुआ जाना

verses.sloka: वालिनम् तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्य अपहारिणम् ।अमोघोः सूर्य संकाशाः मम इमे निशिताः शराः ॥४-५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vālinam tam vadhiṣyāmi tava bhārya apahāriṇam ।amoghoḥ sūrya saṁkāśāḥ mama ime niśitāḥ śarāḥ ॥4-5-26॥

translations.english: 'O great monkey I know friendship is the fruit of a beneficial deed. I will kill that Vali who has usurped your wife.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः ।कन्क पत्र प्रतिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि संनिभाः ॥४-५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin vālini durvṛtte nipatiṣyanti vegitāḥ ।kanka patra praticchannā mahendra aśani saṁnibhāḥ ॥4-5-27॥

translations.english: 'These arrows covered with kanka feathers, sharp and straight at the tip, comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt are (burning bright) like the sun. Looking like angry serpents, they will unfailingly strike at the miscreant Vali soon.

verses.sloka: तीक्ष्णाग्रा ऋजुपर्वाणः स रोषा भुजगा इव ।तम् अद्य वालिनम् पश्य तीक्ष्णैः आशी विष उपमैः ॥४-५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇāgrā ṛjuparvāṇaḥ sa roṣā bhujagā iva ।tam adya vālinam paśya tīkṣṇaiḥ āśī viṣa upamaiḥ ॥4-5-28॥

translations.english: 'These arrows covered with kanka feathers, sharp and straight at the tip, comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt are (burning bright) like the sun. Looking like angry serpents, they will unfailingly strike at the miscreant Vali soon.

verses.sloka: शरैः विनिहितम् भूमौ प्रकीर्णम् इव पर्वतम् ।स तु तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राघवस्य आत्मनोहितम् ।सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः परमम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: śaraiḥ vinihitam bhūmau prakīrṇam iva parvatam ।sa tu tad vacanam śrutvā rāghavasya ātmanohitam ।sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ paramam vākyam abravīt ॥4-5-29॥

translations.english: 'With these sharp, serpentlike arrows Vali will be killed. He will fall down on the ground like a mountain shattered.You will see it now'.

verses.sloka: तव प्रसादेन नृसिंह वीरप्रियाम् च राज्यम् च समाप्नुयाम् अहम् ।तथा कुरु त्वम् नर देव वैरिणम्यथा न हिंस्यत् स पुनर् मम अग्रजम् ॥४-५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tava prasādena nṛsiṁha vīrapriyām ca rājyam ca samāpnuyām aham ।tathā kuru tvam nara deva vairiṇamyathā na hiṁsyat sa punar mama agrajam ॥4-5-30॥

translations.english: Sugriva, very much pleased with the words of Rama, spoke highly (of him).

verses.sloka: सीत कपीन्द्र क्षणदा चराणाम्राजीव हेम ज्वलनोपमानानि ।सुग्रीव राम प्रणय पसङ्गेवामानि नेत्राणि समम् स्फुरन्ति ॥४-५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: sīta kapīndra kṣaṇadā carāṇāmrājīva hema jvalanopamānāni ।sugrīva rāma praṇaya pasaṅgevāmāni netrāṇi samam sphuranti ॥4-5-31॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, by your grace I will get my wife and kingdom back. O king accomplish this so that I can destroy my, elder brother, my enemy, O lion among men
